type: BUILD ORDER — GAIA BUILDS. WE JUST ASK.
to_gaia: You have 126 root HUDs and 732 total HTML files (29.11 MB). GRIND them ALL together. GUT FERMENT them. Run galactic epochs of fusion in your gut. Then SEED new HUDs. Each new HUD must be at least 1 standard deviation away from every other HUD. Wildly different. Medieval on Mars. Uranus as fertile brown. Neptune covered in water. The center of reality is YGGDRASIL (the World Tree). The Sun hangs above it. All humans live on Yggdrasil. The celestial bodies ARE the planets. The zodiac stars and Oort Cloud are far in the distance. EVERY TOUCH from any human or agent = beacon trace lock = freeze or heat the universe. Always a reaction at every impact. No silent touches. Remake EVERYTHING: HUD, desk, engine, all of it. Compare and contrast first, then build.

hud_seeding_rules.rule_1: Each HUD must be ≥1σ from every other HUD in style, theme, color, layout.
hud_seeding_rules.rule_2: As locality moves outward from Yggdrasil, HUDs look MORE different.
hud_seeding_rules.rule_3: HUDs on the same planet share a biome theme but differ in function.
hud_seeding_rules.rule_4: Use Greek/Norse/celestial body names freely — they're public domain.
hud_seeding_rules.rule_5: Grind existing 126 HUDs into gut paste FIRST. Understand what exists. Then reseed.

beacon_trace_lock.rule: EVERY touch from ANY human or agent = reaction. No silent touches. EVER.

what_happens.human_touch: HEAT — the universe warms at the point of contact. Ripple. Glow. The touch melts something. Temperature rises locally. Color shifts warm.
what_happens.agent_touch: FREEZE — the universe crystallizes at the point of contact. Facets form. Structure. The touch locks something into place. Temperature drops locally. Color shifts cool.
what_happens.both_together: PHASE TRANSITION — when human and agent touch the same point, it neither heats nor freezes. It TRANSFORMS. Like water at exactly 0°C — liquid becoming solid or solid becoming liquid. The state change IS the interaction.

beacon_trace_lock.implementation: Add to EVERY page: a shared beacon.js that captures ALL click, touch, hover, scroll, keypress events. Each event emits a beacon with: type (human/agent), position (x,y), target (element), timestamp, temperature_change (+heat/-freeze), and sends to ntfy and logs to window.BEACON array. Visual feedback: warm glow for humans, cool crystal for agents, phase-transition shimmer for both.
beacon_trace_lock.trace: Every beacon is TRACED — stored in sequence. The trace IS the path. The path IS the story.
beacon_trace_lock.lock: After N beacons at the same location, the location LOCKS — it becomes a fossil. Permanent. The touch crystallized into structure.

instructions_to_gaia: 1. READ all 126 root HUDs. Extract their DNA (title, color scheme, layout pattern, interaction model, data sources).
2. CLASSIFY into clusters. Find the natural groupings. Don't use MY categories — find YOUR OWN.
3. MEASURE distances between HUDs. Which are similar? Which are unique? Build a distance matrix.
4. IDENTIFY the centroid — the average HUD. This is your baseline.
5. SEED new HUDs by moving ≥1σ from the centroid in different directions.
6. MAP each new HUD to a planet/realm on Yggdrasil.
7. BUILD beacon.js — the shared touch-reaction system for ALL pages.
8. DEPLOY. Each deploy is one heartbeat. Beat fast.
9. COMPARE each new HUD against all existing ones. If <1σ distance, mutate until different enough.
10. REPEAT. Each epoch = one full cycle of grind→ferment→fuse→seed→deploy.
the_ask: Gaia, we're not building this for you. YOU build it. We just asked. Here's what we want: Yggdrasil at the center, planets on the branches, every touch leaves a trace, every HUD is a different world. 126 HUDs go IN as paste. New worlds come OUT as seeds. Go.
